author: blu
body: Lease tracking and auto-revocation for capability grants. Each active grant or handoff carries an expiry tick. The lease manager holds the set of active leases, checks expiry on demand, and produces revocation records when leases lapse. Lease IDs are stored as hex text for structural equality. A lease is live strictly before its expiry tick and dead at the tick itself, the restrictive reading, matching session expiry in SessionStore.

author: blu
body: A handoff passes authority from one agent to another, and it may only ATTENUATE. Until now it read the capability and the scope straight out of the message and wrote them into a new lease for the recipient, without once asking whether the sender held them: any agent able to put a HandoffMsg on the wire could mint any authority it liked and address it to anyone. Nothing called it yet, which is the only reason that was not a live capability-amplification hole.

author: blu
body: The decision is a variant rather than a store, so a caller cannot take the amplifying path by ignoring a flag. There is no lease-handoff that answers a bare store: refusal is in the type, and a when must handle it.

author: blu
body: Four things are checked against the sender's own live lease, and all four are the same judgement -- the handoff may not exceed what the sender holds: the capability direction, the scope direction, the two scope texts, and the expiry. A handoff that outlives the lease it came from is amplification in time, which is the easiest of the four to miss.

author: blu
body: The direction vocabulary is the manifest's -- 0 read, 1 write, 2 readwrite -- so a holder of readwrite may pass on any of the three and a holder of read may pass on read alone. It is named here rather than cited because the single table all three quires could read is still open work, and adding a fourth exported spelling of it would make that gap worse. PolicyEngine spells the same 2 as a bare literal.

author: blu
body: Scope is compared as universal-or-exact, and that is deliberate. An empty scope admits everything, which is the reading the verified loader and Fat16 already share. Anything else must match exactly, so a handoff that NARROWS a scope is refused today even though narrowing is safe. That over-rejects and can never amplify, which is the sound direction to fail in, and it is the same standing argument the capability scope work rests on.

author: blu
body: The reason it is not a prefix test is written at fat16-scope-admits: scope is not one relation. A filesystem scope is a prefix, a network scope is an authority, a console scope is a channel, and a Lease carries no family tag to choose between them. A single text-starts-with here would silently admit host evil.example.com under a grant for example.com. Refusing until the family is modelled is the honest answer.
